legend: Childan is making up a legendary story and trying to sell his forgery — a necklace with a strong sense of "Wu" to the Kasouras. But Mr. Kasoura is challenging the truth of Childan's story. So he is going to ask a few questions about Childan's so-called "personal treasure" necklace.
This "personal treasure" is a multiset S$$$S$$$ of m$$$m$$$ "01-strings".

A "01-string" is a string that contains n$$$n$$$ characters "0" and "1". For example, if n=4$$$n=4$$$, strings "0110", "0000", and "1110" are "01-strings", but "00110" (there are 5$$$5$$$ characters, not 4$$$4$$$) and "zero" (unallowed characters) are not.
Note that the multiset S$$$S$$$ can contain equal elements.

Frequently, Mr. Kasoura will provide a "01-string" t$$$t$$$ and ask Childan how many strings s$$$s$$$ are in the multiset S$$$S$$$ such that the "Wu" value of the pair (s,t)$$$(s, t)$$$ is not greater than k$$$k$$$.

Mrs. Kasoura and Mr. Kasoura think that if si=ti$$$s_i = t_i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1\leq i\leq n$$$) then the "Wu" value of the character pair equals to wi$$$w_i$$$, otherwise 0$$$0$$$. The "Wu" value of the "01-string" pair is the sum of the "Wu" values of every character pair. Note that the length of every "01-string" is equal to n$$$n$$$.

For example, if w=[4,5,3,6]$$$w=[4, 5, 3, 6]$$$, "Wu" of ("1001", "1100") is 7$$$7$$$ because these strings have equal characters only on the first and third positions, so w1+w3=4+3=7$$$w_1+w_3=4+3=7$$$.
You need to help Childan to answer Mr. Kasoura's queries. That is to find the number of strings in the multiset S$$$S$$$ such that the "Wu" value of the pair is not greater than k$$$k$$$.
input: The first line contains three integers n$$$n$$$, m$$$m$$$, and q$$$q$$$ (1≤n≤12$$$1\leq n\leq 12$$$, 1≤q,m≤5⋅105$$$1\leq q, m\leq 5\cdot 10^5$$$) — the length of the "01-strings", the size of the multiset S$$$S$$$, and the number of queries.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers w1,w2,…,wn$$$w_1, w_2, \ldots, w_n$$$ (0≤wi≤100$$$0 \le w_i \le 100$$$) — the value of the i$$$i$$$-th caracter.
Each of the next m$$$m$$$ lines contains the "01-string" s$$$s$$$ of length n$$$n$$$ — the string in the multiset S$$$S$$$.
Each of the next q$$$q$$$ lines contains the "01-string" t$$$t$$$ of length n$$$n$$$ and integer k$$$k$$$ (0≤k≤100$$$0\leq k\leq 100$$$) — the query.
output: For each query, print the answer for this query.
note: In the first example, we can get:
In the first query, pairs ("11", "00") and ("10", "00") satisfy the condition since their "Wu" is not greater than 20$$$20$$$.
In the second query, all strings satisfy the condition.
In the third query, pairs ("01", "11") and ("01", "11") satisfy the condition. Note that since there are two "01" strings in the multiset, the answer is 2$$$2$$$, not 1$$$1$$$.
In the fourth query, since k$$$k$$$ was increased, pair ("10", "11") satisfies the condition too.
In the fifth query, since k$$$k$$$ was increased, pair ("11", "11") satisfies the condition too.

legend.ai: Childan 正在编造一个传奇故事，并试图向 Kasouras 出售他的赝品——一条带有浓厚“Wu”气息的项链。但 Kasoura 先生正在质疑 Childan 故事的真实性。因此，他准备询问一些关于 Childan 所谓“个人珍宝”项链的问题。
这个“个人珍宝”是一个多重集合 S$$$S$$$，其中包含 m$$$m$$$ 个“01 串”。
注意，多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 中可以包含相同的元素。
Kasoura 先生经常会给出一个“01 串”t$$$t$$$，并询问 Childan 多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 中有多少个字符串 s$$$s$$$，使得字符串对 (s,t)$$$(s, t)$$$ 的“Wu”值不大于 k$$$k$$$。
Kasoura 女士和 Kasoura 先生认为，如果 si=ti$$$s_i = t_i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1\leq i\leq n$$$)，则对应字符对的“Wu”值等于 wi$$$w_i$$$，否则为 0$$$0$$$。两个“01 串”组成的字符串对的“Wu”值，是每一对对应字符的“Wu”值之和。注意，每个“01 串”的长度都等于 n$$$n$$$。
你需要帮助 Childan 回答 Kasoura 先生的查询。也就是说，求多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 中满足字符串对的“Wu”值不大于 k$$$k$$$ 的字符串数量。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n$$$n$$$、m$$$m$$$ 和 q$$$q$$$(1≤n≤12$$$1\leq n\leq 12$$$，1≤q,m≤5⋅105$$$1\leq q, m\leq 5\cdot 10^5$$$)，分别表示“01 串”的长度、多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 的大小以及查询次数。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 w1,w2,…,wn$$$w_1, w_2, \ldots, w_n$$$(0≤wi≤100$$$0 \le w_i \le 100$$$)，表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个字符的值。
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行每行包含一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的“01 串” s$$$s$$$，表示多重集合 S$$$S$$$ 中的字符串。
接下来的 q$$$q$$$ 行每行包含一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的“01 串” t$$$t$$$ 和一个整数 k$$$k$$$(0≤k≤100$$$0\leq k\leq 100$$$)，表示一次查询。

output.ai: 对于每次查询，输出该查询的答案。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，我们可以得到：
在第二次查询中，所有字符串都满足条件。
在第三次查询中，数对("01"，"11")和("01"，"11")满足条件。注意，由于多重集合中有两个 "01" 字符串，答案是 2$$$2$$$，而不是 1$$$1$$$。
在第四次查询中，由于 k$$$k$$$ 增大了，数对("10"，"11")也满足条件。
在第五次查询中，由于 k$$$k$$$ 增大了，数对("11"，"11")也满足条件。
